notes: Version 2.3 corrects the status of the SU(2) sector, following the Q6a 2.3 audit. The admissibility constraints restrict the algebraic structure of the fibre but do not select it; the SU(2) structure of the spin-1/2 sector enters through the spinor carrier supplied conditionally by O23, whose selection is open. The summary table lists the SU(2) gauge structure as conditional on that supplied carrier (admissible factorisation of O27 and Q6a 2.3), not as proved. No Foundation theorem is changed.
